data.name: Daneer
data.gender_notes: Daneer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Daneer is derived from the Arabic word ‘daniyah’, which means ‘to protect’, ‘to defend’, or ‘to fortify’. In Islamic history, the name Daneer has been given to children born to protect their families or communities from harm. This name is a reminder of the importance of courage, strength, and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage and bravery in the face of challenges and adversity.
data.etymology: Daneer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Defender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daneer total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: دينير
in_arabic.meaning: دينير اسم يعني منير ومشرف في الدين
in_arabic.long_meaning: دينير هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه منير ومشرف في الدين، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني رفيعة و حميدة في الإسلام. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياق التعبير عن الإيمان و التنوير الروحي.

in_urdu.name: دینیر
in_urdu.meaning: دینیر کا مطلب ہے دین میں منیر اور مشرف
in_urdu.long_meaning: دینیر ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے دین میں منیر اور مشرف ہونا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ ایمان اور روحانی روشناسی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दीनیر
in_hindi.meaning: दीनीर का अर्थ है धर्म में उज्ज्वल और सम्मानित
in_hindi.long_meaning: दीनीर एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है धर्म में उज्ज्वल और सम्मानित होना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह विश्वास और आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान का प्रतीक है।

in_english.name: Daneer
in_english.meaning: Daneer means enlightened and honored in faith
in_english.long_meaning: Daneer is a masculine name of Arabic origin. It means enlightened and honored in faith. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'D-Y-N', it signifies spiritual illumination and high esteem in Islam. Historically, the name reflects the values of religious devotion and moral integrity. Daneer is used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person of strong faith and character.
